page.layout: One text column with a running head above it. Marginal notes in the right margin (Psalm reference beside "laetantium", Matth. 21 beside "Pueruli", Chrysostom beside "Pro"). Below the text block, a small-type note (number 8) beginning "Nullusq;" that runs to "Pueruli." Catchword "qui" at the lower right, signature "C 2" at the lower left.

main_text.p: quasi faliare celebrant conuiuium. Inter tot tamen & tales, intrusas veluti in manus peccandi ansas. Nullus applicuit manum ad os suum, quod secundo in loco est dispiciendum.

8 Nullusq; applicuit manum ad os suum] Plerunq, evenit, vt in Minimis maxima elucescant virtutum exempla: Ex ore laetantiumPs. 8. [?] perficit Deus laudem, & vbi tacent Pharisaei, aut indignantur, Hosanna clamant Pueruli.Matth. 21.

Quinam fuerunt isti & quales, qui tam religiosae obedientiae, tam deprædicandum hîc præbent specimen. Accepistis ὡς ὃ πάντως [?] in præcedentibus, עם [?] populus ingrediebatur sylvam, & audietis in sequentibus, העם Populus timebat Iuramentum, populus igitur erat, & non populi flores delibati. E nostris forsan Institutionibus si interfuissent nonnulli, arripuissent potius virgulam censoriam, & Magistratui procaciter sic dicam impegissent. Quid sibi vult Rex noster, vt nos in tales angustias redigeret. Nunquid præcepit Deus? Extorsit Necessitas? suaserit vtilitas? Vt tam præcipiti Anathemate nos innodaret? An ita mancipati sumus alicujus superioris obsequio? Vt proChrysost. ad Antioch. p.14. lege staret ipsius Temeritas, præsertim nobis

page.notes: Page number at the foot right reads "76" (printed), not transcribed as the page number; the head reads "19". Marginal reference beside "laetantium" is partly unclear (read as "Ps. 8." [?]). Greek "ὡς ὃ πάντως" and the first Hebrew word are uncertain. The Chrysostom reference is set in small type and read with some doubt. The footnote "8" is a commentary note set in the column in smaller type.
